name: pi-tool-guard
description: Pi extension: runs an expensive bash command once and keeps its full log so the agent reads any slice instead of re-running, repairs LLM tool-call arguments (edit/write/read aliases plus trailing head/tail/grep pipeline extractors), and renames a misspell
